name: Bishop
description: Move the robber. You may draw 1 random card (resource or commodity) from the hand of each player who has a settlement or city adjacent to the robber's new hex.

name: Constitution
description: 1 Victory Point! Reveal this card immediately when you draw it. This card cannot be stolen by a spy.

name: Deserter
description: Choose an opponent. He must remove 1 of his knights of his choice from the board. In return, you may play 1 of your own knights on the board that is of equal strength to the one removed.

name: Diplomat
description: You may remove any open road (a road with nothing - including settlements or cities - attached at one end. If you remove one of your own roads, you may place it in another location.

name: Intrigue
description: You may displace one of you opponent's knights, without using a knight of your own. The knight must be on an intersection connected to one of your roads or lines of ships.

name: Saboteur
description: Each player who has as many or more victory points than you must discard half his cards to the bank (resource and/or commodity)

name: Spy
description: Examine an opponent's hand of progress cards. You may take 1 card of your choice and add it to your hand.

name: Warlord
description: You may activate all of your knights for free.

name: Wedding
description: Each player who has more victory points than you must give you 2 cards of his choice (resource and/or commodity).

name: Commercial Harbor
description: You may offer each opponent a resource card from your hand. In exchange, each player must give you a commodity card of his choice. If he has none, your resource card is returned.

name: Master Merchant
description: Select an opponent who has more victory points than you. You may examine his hand of resource cards and select any 2 cards, which you may add to your hand.

name: Merchant
description: Place the merchant on a land hex next to your settlement or city. While the merchant remains here, you may trade the resource produced by this terrain at a 2:1 ratio. Control of the merchant also allots 1 Victory Point.

name: Merchant Fleet
description: For the rest of your turn, you may trade one resource or commodity of your choice with the bank at a 2:1 rate. You may make as many trades as you wish.

name: Resource Monopoly
description: Name a resource (not a commodity). Each opponent must give you 2 cards of that type (if he has any).

name: Trade Monopoly
description: Name a commodity (not a resource). Each opponent must give you 1 card of that type (if he has any).

name: Alchemist
description: Play this card before you roll the dice. You decide what the results of both numbered dice will be. Then roll the event die normally. Resolve the event die first.

name: Crane
description: One city improvement that you build this turn costs one less commodity than usual.

name: Engineer
description: You may build 1 city wall for free.

name: Inventor
description: You may swap 2 number tokens of your choice on the game board. You may not choose any 2, 12, 6, or 8 tokens.

name: Irrigation
description: You may take 2 grain cards from the bank for each fields hex which is adjacent to at least one of your cities or settlements.

name: Medicine
description: For 2 ore and 1 grain, you may upgrade one of your settlements into a city.

name: Mining
description: You may take 2 ore cards from the bank for each mountains hex adjacent to at least one of your cities or settlements.

name: Printer
description: 1 Victory Point! Reveal this card immediately when you draw it. This card cannot be stolen by a spy.

name: Road Building
description: When you play this card, you may place 2 roads for free (if playing with Catan: Seafarers, you may place 2 ships or 1 ship and 1 road instead)

name: Smith
description: You may promote up to 2 of your knights for free (the normal rules for promoting knights still apply). Mighty knights may not be promoted.
